audience: companies that run employee expense claims, approvals and accounting exports in ExpenseOnDemand

useCases.title: Export approved expenses for accounting
useCases.text: List the export templates to find a report id. Then export the approved expenses of that report, filtered by date, category, claimant or cost centre.

useCases.title: Get payroll totals per employee
useCases.text: Get the approved expense total of each employee for payroll. List the users to check the role and status of each employee.

useCases.title: Read categories, cost centres and grades
useCases.text: List the expense categories, cost centres and employee grades of the subscription, with their active flags.

useCases.title: Invite a new employee
useCases.text: List the users first to avoid a duplicate. Then add the employee. ExpenseOnDemand treats the new employee as invited.

useCases.title: Update or deactivate an employee
useCases.text: Read the user record first. Then update the employee by email, or deactivate the employee so they cannot submit or approve expenses. Send every field you keep.

useCases.title: Add or update a customer
useCases.text: List the customers first. Add a new customer, or update one by id. Send every field you keep, because an update can clear the fields you leave out.
